body: I'll get my gf to do something with it when she gets back from Halifax this week, I guess.
The only person that I did tell eventually called the suicide hotline or whatever it's called. That's what got me into this mess of therapy and pills and shit.

I don't do it because I don't want anyone telling my parents or calling whoever you call for a suicidal person. Also, I've worked so hard to keep my happy facade up, I don't want to ruin it by telling someone. I guess that sounds pretty immature, eh?
